home.heroText: Built for the Mission. Driven by the Problem.
home.heroSubText: Modern software, innovative solutions, and technology built around the needs of Soldiers.
home.aboutText: The Operational Data Section is an XVIII Airborne Corps unit dedicated to solving operational challenges through modern software engineering and data-driven solutions. Working directly with Soldiers and leaders, we identify problems, develop capabilities, and deliver technology that enhances readiness, improves decision-making, and supports mission success. Our approach combines operational expertise with user-centered design and rapid, iterative development.
home.workText: From mission planning and readiness tools to operational software and data integration, we develop capabilities that solve real problems and empower Soldiers across the force.
home.contactText: Connect with the ODS to explore how we can turn your problem into a mission-ready solution.

about.text:
The Operational Data Section supports XVIII Airborne Corps by developing modern software and data capabilities that address operational challenges and enhance mission effectiveness.

OUR MISSION

To empower Soldiers and leaders through innovative, mission-focused technology that improves operational readiness, streamlines processes, and enables informed decision-making across the Corps.

WHO WE ARE

ODS brings together military expertise and modern software development practices to solve real-world problems. By working directly with the Soldiers who experience these challenges, we identify opportunities for improvement and rapidly deliver practical, user-centered solutions. Our team emphasizes collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivering meaningful capabilities to the force.

work.text: Explore the software and data capabilities developed in partnership with Soldiers and operational stakeholders. Each solution begins with a real-world challenge and is designed to improve workflows, strengthen readiness, and support mission success.

items.title: LASSI
items.description: The LASSI project was a project where our team partnered with the 82nd Airborne Division to build a drone operations management system.

items.title: DriverReady
items.description: DriverReady is a driver training and certification app. It provides interactive lessons and assessments to ensure drivers are properly trained and certified. items.title: RotorTrax
items.description: A tool for the G32 to track and manage the movement of aircraft and personnel.

items.title: SkyView
items.description: Tracking of equipment and personnel as it boards aircrafts.

items.title: Vantage Tool 2
items.description: Some vantage thing haleys team did

items.title: LOGTAK
items.description: LOGTAK is a logistics management application designed to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

items.title: AmmoOp
items.description: AmmoOp is an ammo calculator app. Tell it the event and number of shooters and it will calculate the amount of ammo needed for the event.

items.title: EXFIL
items.description: An app made for managing and tracking logistics operations.

items.title: STIG Viewer
items.description: STIG Viewer is an internal tool designed to help users identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in their systems. It provides a comprehensive solution for managing and tracking STIG compliance across the organization.

items.title: FULCRUM
items.description: FULCRUM is a cloud infrastructure solution specific for the corps, and the first of its kind in the army.

items.title: PRIMUS
items.description: Primus is a starter application that was stig compliant and ato approved for use within the corp.

items.title: LF-DCSA
items.description: LF-DCSA was a much more streamlined version of SRP. It took inspiration from both SRP and SHIELD and was packaged into a product for a customer.

items.title: LET
items.description: The Leader Engagement Tool was designed a place leaders could engage with each other internally. It had a system for reporting incidents.

items.title: SHIELD
items.description: SHIELD was the evolution of SRP. Shield was designed as a much improved and comprehensive version of the original SRP concept.

items.title: SRP
items.description: SRP was the original vision for the corp to build a readiness platform that supported the newly incorporated H2F program.

items.title: Sentinel
items.description: Sentinel was the first project that the ODS team worked on (At the time we were considered the DWC or Data Warfare Company). It was an application designed to streamline the way that an s3 schools section files there paperwork.
